_note: Curated, reasoned endings of catalogue searches (iteration 3, closed-loop demonstration, scientist-b, 2026-10-28). Read by repurposing_join.py handoff. A disposition is a decision about a search, not a claim about biology and not a ranking. Coverage version used: main 315cd50c (before the ABAT / GtoPdb artefact correction of task/it3-search2).

dispositions.subject: apinocaltamide (reverse path: compound without a card -> CACNA1G/H/I -> need)
dispositions.why: ChEMBL curated mechanism (T-type blocker, three subtypes) coherent with a direction-evaluable need; structurally unrelated to ethosuximide, the only drug result of the need. Mechanism-level discriminator only; apinocaltamide sources are abstract-level, adult rodents and healthy adults.
dispositions.reopening_condition: closes if a same-day-controlled Wwox-null pup assay with measured exposure does not reproduce the ethosuximide late-phase effect; weakens if a full-text read shows no brain exposure at pup-relevant conditions
dispositions.next_experiment: Wwox-null pup PTZ late-phase score, three genotypes, concurrent PTZ-alone control, ethosuximide and apinocaltamide arms, exposure measured, pre-planned drug-by-genotype interaction test

dispositions.subject: glycine and aspartic acid (NMDA-receptor agonists)
dispositions.why: Stated action is agonism of GRIN2A/GRIN2B, the opposite sign to a need whose direction is down; ChEMBL holds no mechanism row for either (DGIdb / Guide to Pharmacology ligand statements only). They are dietary amino acids: no repurposing question follows.
dispositions.reopening_condition: a Wwox-deficient system showing NMDA-receptor hypofunction (the need's sign would then be up)
dispositions.next_experiment: none for these compounds; the sign of the need is decided by the MEA / d-APV experiment already named on card F01_glutamate_receptor_node

dispositions.subject: adenosine and regadenoson flagged 'opposed' through ABAT
dispositions.why: The 'opposed' flag rests on one Guide-to-Pharmacology ligand row 'ABAT agonist' beside a run of unrelated ABC-transporter rows; the compounds' real pharmacology is at adenosine receptors, which are not targets of this need. Neither an opposite nor a consistent mechanism is established.
dispositions.reopening_condition: a ChEMBL curated mechanism row or a primary paper stating an action on GABA transaminase
dispositions.next_experiment: none; correct the coverage layer (coordinator task it3-search2)

dispositions.subject: GCN2 (EIF2AK4), from the fly PARS2 reading
dispositions.why: Need direction is uncertain, so exploration only. The catalogue holds no ChEMBL mechanism row for EIF2AK4; DGIdb returns five antipsychotics through PharmGKB with interaction type unknown (pharmacogenomic association, not modulation) and one multi-kinase research inhibitor. The only GCN2 datum is genetic suppression in a fly model: genetic suppression is not pharmacology.
dispositions.reopening_condition: (i) phospho-GCN2 / ATF4 elevation in a Wwox-deficient neural system, or (ii) a catalogued compound with a stated GCN2 action
dispositions.next_experiment: in a Wwox-deficient neural system measure phospho-GCN2 versus phospho-PERK with eIF2alpha phosphorylation and ATF4 protein (stage 1 of card E01, plus the kinase question), before any compound

dispositions.subject: pannexin-1 blockers (record Q-N-16) via PANX1
dispositions.why: PANX1 is an intervention target of the need, but the catalogue returns no compound for it (no ChEMBL mechanism row, no DGIdb row). Probenecid, carbenoxolone and brilliant blue G exist in the catalogue under other targets and are not linked by name. The only WWOX datum (one slice, one blocker) is a rise in burst frequency, never tested.
dispositions.reopening_condition: a source row linking a catalogue compound to PANX1, or an independent measurement of a pannexin blocker in a Wwox-deficient network
dispositions.next_experiment: independent replication of the slice experiment with a second pannexin-1 blocker and a significance test (record Q-N-16, REPLICATE row)
